description:
CropSNPdb SNPs in and around a gene (flank bp each side), placed on the dataset's own assembly: pea genes
(Ensembl Cameor v1a Psat IDs, through LIS pangenes, or Cameor v2 Psat. IDs) on the pea panels' Cameor v2,
lentil genes (Lcu.2RBY) on CDC Redberry v2, chickpea genes (kabuli v1 Ca_ or v3 Ca1g IDs) on CDC Frontier v1.
dataset: 'pea' (default for pea genes), 'pea_ams', 'lentil' or 'chickpea'; lines: up to 50 line names to
return their genotype calls as well. Say how the gene was placed (the 'via' field).
name: snp_gene
